::: callout-note
This page is a **prototype**, not a finished lesson. It's here to test one idea: can the *exact same* analysis code run on two completely different datasets, with nothing but the data itself swapped out? Everything below is live and editable — nothing is pre-rendered.
:::

### Pick your show

Run the block below as-is to work with **Doctor Who**. To switch to **The Simpsons**, change the file path on the first line and re-run this block *and every block below it*.

```{webr-r}
show_data <- "https://davidabrocker.com/data/doctorwho_ratings.csv"
# show_data <- "https://davidabrocker.com/data/simpsons_ratings.csv"

ratings <- read.csv(show_data)
head(ratings)
```

::: callout-tip
**Try it out:** Comment out the Doctor Who line, uncomment the Simpsons line, and re-run. Then re-run each block below — same code, different show.
:::

```{webr-r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

quality_colors <- c(
  "Great"   = "#AD0000",
  "Good"    = "#1B4B72",
  "Regular" = "#C98A2C",
  "Bad"     = "#888888",
  "Garbage" = "#4A4A4A"
)
```

### Average rating by season

```{webr-r}
ratings |>
  ggplot(aes(as.factor(Season), Ratings)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Quality), alpha = .3) +
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "point", size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = quality_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Season", y = "Rating", title = "Average Rating by Season")
```

### Which season had the most standout episodes?

```{webr-r}
ratings |>
  filter(Quality == "Great") |>
  count(Season) |>
  ggplot(aes(fct_reorder(as.factor(Season), n), n)) +
  geom_col(fill = quality_colors[["Great"]]) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Season", y = "Count", title = "'Great' Episodes per Season")
```

### Every episode, at a glance

```{webr-r}
ratings |>
  ggplot(aes(factor(Season), EpisodeNumber, fill = Quality)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Ratings), size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = quality_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Season", y = "Episode", title = "Episode Heatmap")
```

::: callout-important
The lesson code above never references "Doctor Who" or "The Simpsons" by name — it only depends on `Season`, `EpisodeNumber`, `Ratings`, and `Quality` columns existing. Any new show's data can be added the same way: clean it into that shape, drop the CSV in `data/`, and it plugs into this exact lesson.
:::
